title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, improve cache and bump actions
author: Ari Chen
title_line: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, improve cache and bump actions
description: Why: CI workflows had drifted (multiple overlapping lint/test matrices, duplicated caching logic, and flaky release automation) which increased developer friction and CI minutes. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of composable GitHub Actions pipelines, upgrades key actions to current recommended versions, standardizes caching logic for node and python jobs, and improves release action reliability by adding artifact validation and retry logic. Scope: .github/workflows/* (lint, test, release), tools/ci/* scripts, package.json devDeps bump, docs/ci.md. Checklist: [x] consolidate workflows into reusable workflow_call templates; [x] upgrade actions (checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4); [x] harmonize cache keys and restore logic; [x] add integration test gating for release job; [x] add diagnostics and trace logs for flaky tests; [x] update docs and quickstart. Notes: This is primarily a repo hygiene and developer experience change; no runtime changes to serving code. See linear: ENG-3421 for motivation and rollout plan, ENG-3490 for release flakiness investigation.
commits: consolidate: move lint/test matrices into workflows/templates/{lint,test}.yml
ci: introduce workflows/templates/common-steps.yml for shared setup and cache logic
ci: bump actions (checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and update syntax
chore: add release validation step and retry wrapper
docs: update docs/ci.md with new workflow examples and troubleshooting
diff_summary: Replaced 3 separate workflow files with 3 workflow entrypoints that call shared templates; added cache-utils.sh for stable key generation; bumped devDependencies in package.json; small docs updates.
review_comments: Morgan Patel (reviewer): Please collapse repeated 'uses' blocks into the common template and confirm that cache key includes OS + node-version + hash(package-lock.json);
Ari Chen (author): Addressed - moved common steps to templates/common-steps.yml and switched cache key to 'node-${{ runner.os }}-${{ inputs.node-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}'
Samir Rao (reviewer): CI matrix looks good, but the integration tests sometimes fail due to DB seed timing — can we add a retry and diagnostic output?
Ari Chen (author): Added retry wrapper around the integration test job and expanded logs; also added a short sleep with backoff for DB seed to reduce flakiness.
Nina Gomez (approver): Verified release job now includes artifact checksum validation; approving once CI passes.
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky on first run (seed timing), rerun succeeded after retry wrapper
ci_notes: Observed ~25% reduction in total CI minutes for lint/test pipelines due to cache reuse and smaller matrices; cache hit rate improved after harmonizing keys.
review_flow: Opened as draft while scoped changes were validated; moved out of draft after tests stabilized. Two rounds of review: general refactor + follow-up fix for a flaky integration test. Final approval by Nina Gomez and Samir Rao. Merge performed after CI green and Linear checks confirmed.
release_notes: CI: Unify lint/test/release workflows into reusable templates, bump GitHub Actions to recommended versions, improve caching and reduce CI time, add release artifact validation and retry logic for flaky tests.
post_merge_actions: monitor ci run for next 72h for regression in cache hit rates
announce workflow changes in #dev-tools with migration notes
follow-up: schedule ENG-3490 to instrument additional release metrics
